mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_policy ( user_id, ai_enabled_override, daily_request_limit_override, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{aiEnabledOverride}, #{dailyRequestLimitOverride}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET ai_enabled_override = EXCLUDED.ai_enabled_override, daily_request_limit_override = EXCLUDED.daily_request_limit_override, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
